UmbracoDefinition.description: Configuration container for all Umbraco products.

UmbracoStorageProvidersAzureBlobDefiniti.description: Configuration of Umbraco Storage Providers - Azure Blob Storage.

AzureBlobFileSystemOptions.description: The Azure Blob File System options.

ConnectionString.description: Gets or sets the storage account connection string.

ContainerName.description: Gets or sets the container name.

ContainerRootPath.description: Gets or sets the root path of the container.

VirtualPath.description: Gets or sets the virtual path.

EnableFileProviderMetadataCache.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether file provider metadata should be cached.

FileProviderMetadataCacheDuration.description: Gets or sets the file provider metadata cache duration (TimeSpan).

AzureBlobImageSharpCacheOptions.description: Configuration options for Azure Blob Storage ImageSharp cache behavior.

EnableMetadataCache.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether cache metadata should be stored in memory.

MetadataCacheDuration.description: Gets or sets the metadata cache duration (TimeSpan).

MaxConcurrentImageRequests.description: Gets or sets the maximum number of concurrent cache operations. Set to 0 or less to disable.
